description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling CRUD operations related to 'connectors'. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting connector records, utilizing various imported schemas and service functions.

methods.name: list_connectors(tenant_id: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by tenant_id"))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all connectors, with optional filtering by tenant_id.

methods.name: create_connector(payload: ConnectorCreateRequest)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new connector record.

methods.name: get_connector(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a connector by its ID.

methods.name: update_connector(connector_id: str, payload: ConnectorUpdateRequest)
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the label or config of a connector.

methods.name: delete_connector(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a connector by its ID.

ctags.name: list_connectors
ctags.pattern: /^def list_connectors(tenant_id: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by tenant_id/
ctags.signature: (tenant_id: str | None = Query(default=None, description="Filter by tenant_id"))
